fields.summary_ko.0: Bank of America maintains Buy rating on Apple (AAPL) with price target of $385 (11% upside from current $345.71), judging that future 12-month cash generation and massive installed base will offset margin pressure.
fields.summary_ko.1: Apple guided December quarter operating margin to 45%–46% lower end, yet record quarterly profit and $114.48B revenue (exceeding consensus $113.36B), plus iPhone new product supply constraints, are positive factors.
